backlog.title: Phase D1 — Answer pinning (ANSWER-PIN-001 / FR-35, spec M9)
backlog.description: A recorded answer owns the caret in every view and on every entry path; same-value commits are inert no-ops that only advance; FR-18 confirm fires only on an explicit different choice; ★ answered marker on the short-view question line. Only the unshipped remainder of the spec (de633b0) — everything else in the PRD diff already shipped through c7d44c0 (cite, don't rebuild). Non-goals: no config surface, no auto-submit/gate changes, no state-machine/rev/epoch/persistence changes.

milestones.title: D1.M1 — The caret follows the recorded answer
milestones.description: Single milestone delivering FR-D8 (cursor seeding pins to the recorded answer), FR-D9 (inert same-value commits on all accept paths), FR-D10 (★ answered marker), the status-agnostic-preselect comment purge, test flips, AC-16, and changeset-level docs.

tasks.title: FR-D8 — Cursor seeding pins to the recorded answer
tasks.description: initialCursorIndex returns the recorded answer's position instead of the status-agnostic ★ preselect; the three seed sites inherit automatically (comments only); tool-schema recommendation description becomes spec-verbatim.

subtasks.title: Rewrite initialCursorIndex: the recorded answer owns the caret
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_f8af1c6f6c49/architecture/panel-ui-seams.md §Cursor-seeding — src/panel/short-view.ts:119 `initialCursorIndex(q: Question): number` today returns the DISPLAY row of the ★ recommendation regardless of q.answer; `displayOptions` (same file) implements the D-R13 recommended-first DISPLAY order; the ✎ Other row sits at index options.length; accent highlight on the recorded row already exists (commit 32a1f6e) — only caret placement is missing.
2. INPUT: the question record q with `answer?: { value, custom?: true, at }` (shape per architecture/answer-pinning-contract.md) and status ∈ {answered, submitted, closed, moot, withdrawn, re-asked}; displayOptions(q) ordering.
3. LOGIC: Implement FR-D8/FR-35 (spec h2.8/h3.5): when q.answer present (any status carrying an answer, moot keeps its dimmed answer): custom:true → options.length (✎ row); choice + option value → DISPLAY row of answer.value mapped through displayOptions order; value no longer in options → clamp to row 0 (NEVER the recommendation); type:"text" → 0. No answer → today's ★ preselect unchanged (display row of recommendation, clamp 0). R2 intact: ★ stays visible on its own row but never owns the caret when an answer exists. Tests: flip the ★-preselect-on-revisit rows in src/panel/short-view.test.ts; add the stale-value-clamps-to-row-0 test (★ recommendation present, answer.value absent from options). Mock nothing external — scripted vitest only (plan/001 AUTOMATION-POLICY).
4. OUTPUT: new initialCursorIndex(q): number, signature unchanged — consumed automatically by the three seed sites (P1.M1.T1.S2 touches their comments only) and by the no-op tests in P1.M1.T2.S4.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on initialCursorIndex + rewrite the "WHY ★ AND PRESELECT COEXIST" comment block (short-view.ts ~22-28 and ~117-123) to state the pinning contract — rides with this work, no separate docs subtask.

tasks.title: FR-D9 — Inert same-value commits on the accept paths
tasks.description: enter/digit on the already-recorded value is a state NO-OP (advance only): no ripple seam, no applyAnswer, no evaluateDependsOn, no maybeAutoSubmit, no answer.at rewrite; byte-identical write-in re-commits inert with buffer consumed; acceptFromDeep treats no-op as accept; FR-18 modal fires only on an explicit different choice.

subtasks.title: acceptOptionIndex: same-value commit is an inert NO-OP (digit inherits)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: plan/003_f8af1c6f6c49/architecture/panel-ui-seams.md §Accept-paths — src/panel/actions.ts:244 `acceptOptionIndex(panel, q, optionIndex): boolean`; ripple seam at :255 `if (!panel.confirmRippleEdit(q.id, proposed)) return true; // seam vetoed`; maybeAutoSubmit at :265 (AUTOSUBMIT-001/003 transition-gated); digit path at :196 routes through acceptOptionIndex (`return acceptOptionIndex(panel, q, n - 1)`).
2. INPUT: question record with `answer: { value, custom?, at }` from state; the pinned caret from P1.M1.T1.S1 means enter lands on the recorded row by default.
3. LOGIC: Implement FR-D9: BEFORE the ripple seam at :255, if q.answer exists && !answer.custom && answer.value === proposed option value → state NO-OP: skip confirmRippleEdit, applyAnswer, evaluateDependsOn, maybeAutoSubmit entirely; NO fresh answer.at; advance to next unanswered per the Q14 rhythm only. FR-18 confirm fires only on an explicit DIFFERENT choice. digit inherits via :196 — add an explicit digit-on-recorded-value no-op test (consumed, advance, zero state change: no modal, no epoch bump, no answer.at rewrite). Add maybeAutoSubmit-never-fires-from-no-op test. Mock: none — scripted vitest; the ripple confirm renders through the existing panel test harness.
4. OUTPUT: acceptOptionIndex exposing a THREE-OUTCOME result (NO-OP | ACCEPT | VETO — e.g. return flag/enum) consumed by P1.M1.T2.S6 (acceptFromDeep) and covered by P1.M1.T5.S10's AC-16 test.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on acceptOptionIndex and the digit path stating the no-op contract, citing ANSWER-PIN-001/FR-35; purge the actions.ts ~:278 status-agnostic comment as touched.

subtasks.context_scope:

LOGIC: Implement FR-D9: BEFORE the ripple-victims branch — if (answer.custom === true && buffer === answer.value) OR (type:"text" && answer.value === buffer) → inert no-op: advance only; consume/neutralize the buffer per the VAL-002 pattern so the advance's draft write-through CANNOT stage committed text into the draft slot. Flip the same-value write-in edit assertions at src/panel/actions.test.ts ~:1684-1685 and ~:1829-1836. Mock: none — scripted vitest.
4. OUTPUT: inert writeInEnter with consumed buffer; green flipped tests; consumed-buffer guarantee consumed by P1.M1.T5.S10's AC-16 write-in scenario.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] JSDoc on writeInEnter stating the inert-re-commit + buffer-consume contract; purge actions.ts comments ~:305/329/338-339/353/371 as touched.
